SELECT d.id AS device_id, d.sn, d.name, d.status, d.product_code, d.product_model, d.product_name, d.shipment_time, d.package_no, d.contract_no, d.shipment_record_id, d.project_id, d.customer_id, d.warranty_start_date, d.warranty_end_date, d.warranty_status, d.conp_version, d.conp_type, d.conp_series, d.conp_mark, d.sync_status, d.location_snapshot, d.location_resolution_status, nv.boot_version, nv.cpld_version, w.warranty_months, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ast_device_warranty_record wr WHERE wr.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND wr.device_sn = d.sn AND wr.deleted = b'0' AND wr.extended = b'1') AS extended_count FROM ast_device d LEFT JOIN ast_device_network_version nv ON nv.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND nv.device_sn = d.sn AND nv.deleted = b'0' AND nv.source_system = 'DEVICE_LOG' AND (nv.sync_status IS NULL OR nv.sync_status <> 'NOT_AVAILABLE') LEFT JOIN ast_device_warranty w ON w.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND w.device_sn = d.sn AND w.deleted = b'0' WHERE d.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND d.deleted = b'0'
ORDER BY d.id DESC LIMIT #{query.offset}, #{query.pageSize}
